title: GTA6 Sparks Unlikely Resurgence for 86-Year-Old Cliff Richard
description: British singer Cliff Richard is enjoying a surprising career resurgence at 86 thanks to the GTA6 Netflix Extended Look, even though he still doesn't know what Rockstar Games is.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Unexpected Cultural Reach of GTA6

As the anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to dominate the entertainment world, the marketing campaign has inadvertently triggered a surprising career resurgence for a music legend. According to IGN Games, 86-year-old British singer Cliff Richard is experiencing a renewed wave of popularity.

## The Netflix Extended Look Connection

The unexpected revival was sparked by the inclusion of one of his classic songs in the GTA6 Extended Look, which was released on Netflix. Given the unprecedented global attention and massive viewership surrounding any media tied to Rockstar Games' upcoming title, the featured track quickly caught the ears of modern audiences, thrusting the veteran artist back into the cultural conversation.

## Completely Unaware of the Phenomenon

Despite his classic track being broadcasted to millions of eager gaming fans worldwide through the high-profile video release, it appears that the entire Rockstar Games phenomenon has completely passed him by. At 86 years old, the singer remains largely unaware of the massive digital footprint and gaming community excitement tied to his recent musical spotlight.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar Games has always had an incredible ear for curating soundtracks that define eras. Bringing a classic tune by an 86-year-old artist into the mix via a high-profile Netflix trailer shows just how far-reaching the GTA6 ecosystem is. It is a delightful reminder of how gaming can unexpectedly breathe new life into classic music history.
